waivers.reason: No patched release on the 1.x line — the fix ships only in 5.0.8, and the advisory's <=5.0.7 range sweeps every earlier major. The 1.x copy is reached solely through eslint > minimatch@3 (lint-time dev tooling, not part of any shipped bundle); the fix becomes reachable only via the ESLint 10 major bump tracked separately — drop this waiver when that lands.

Bump next once it requires a patched postcss.
